eps.o: As Rick, Marty and Craig relaunch the team's quest to find the legendary treasure, they are rocked by new discoveries in the Money Pit and in the massive boulder feature on Lot 8.
When the team drills into the man-made stone cradle on Lot 8, they are mystified by the clues that are brought to the surface.
While drilling to find the gold that was detected deep in the Money Pit area, the team makes a surprising and incredible new find.
New finds on Lot 5 and in the Money Pit lift the team's spirits as intriguing historical research reveals the possible truth behind the treasure mystery.
